scope: SBI Remit's XRP-related remittance history, total cross-border remittance scale and new Fasset stablecoin infrastructure MoU

observations.metric: SBI Group voting-rights ownership of SBI Remit
notes: Ownership ratio includes SBI group and companies/funds consolidated under IFRS as stated by SBI.
SBI Remit is not 100% owned by SBI Group.

observations.metric: SBI Remit cumulative remittance handling amount
notes: SBI Remit stated cumulative remittance handling amount exceeded ¥2.5T as of May 29, 2026.
This is total SBI Remit remittance volume across channels/corridors, not XRP-specific volume and not a single-day capital flow.

observations.metric: SBI Remit–Fasset next-generation cross-border remittance infrastructure
observations.quality: official MoU; not a production service
notes: The MoU combines SBI Remit's customer base and remittance network with Fasset's stablecoin payment infrastructure.

Fasset's own reported scale in the SBI release: $32B annual transaction volume, 2M+ digital wallets, 16 blockchain networks and payment routes spanning 50+ banks. These are Fasset-reported claims, not independently verified in this record.
No production launch date, route-level asset mix, fee schedule or XRP role is disclosed.

observations.metric: SBI Group voting-rights ownership of SBI Ripple Asia
notes: SBI Ripple Asia is a separate joint venture/business entity; SBI Group reports 60% voting rights.
This ownership figure is not the same as SBI Group's approximately 9% shareholding in Ripple Labs.
SBI reports an XRP-utilizing remittance service through SBI Remit and expansion to Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia in 2023.
Current XRP-specific transfer volume, market-maker inventory and share of the ¥2.5T total are not disclosed.
SBI Remit added Japanese-yen bank-account remittances alongside local currencies, USD and EUR.
This is a fiat rail expansion, not evidence of XRP usage.
The profile describes bank-account remittance coverage across about 200 countries/regions.
Coverage does not establish active volume in every corridor.

relationship_edges.scope_note: As of 2026-08-28; ownership includes consolidated subsidiaries/funds.
Not XRP-specific; total across remittance channels.
Service started 2021 and expanded to Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia in 2023; current XRP share/volume unknown.
Exploration/partnership agreement; production use and token/chain selection not disclosed.
Separate from SBI's equity interest in Ripple Labs.

hypotheses.claim: SBI Remit is pursuing a multi-rail remittance strategy, retaining XRP-based corridors while adding stablecoin infrastructure through Fasset and fiat options.
supporting: SBI reports an XRP-utilizing remittance service since 2021 and a June 2026 Fasset stablecoin-infrastructure MoU; it also added JPY bank-account remittances.
disconfirming: No evidence yet that Fasset is in production or that XRP routes have been reduced.
hypotheses.test: Compare corridor-level asset routing, transfer costs, settlement times, liquidity-provider inventory and volume before/after Fasset deployment.

hypotheses.claim: Fasset stablecoin rails may substitute for XRP bridge legs in some remittance corridors.
supporting: Fasset describes multi-chain stablecoin payment infrastructure across 16 networks and 50+ banks.
disconfirming: The MoU does not disclose asset selection or a production launch; SBI continues to support XRP corridors.
hypotheses.test: Obtain public route design and post-launch corridor-level settlement-asset mix.

hypotheses.claim: The ¥2.5T cumulative remittance figure demonstrates SBI Remit's scale but cannot be used as XRP transaction volume or token demand.
supporting: The company reports total remittance handling across approximately 200 countries/regions and multiple currencies.
disconfirming: None of the cited sources allocates the total by asset or channel.
hypotheses.test: Seek XRP-specific volume disclosures or independent on-chain/partner data; otherwise keep the metric as total network scale only.

unknowns: XRP share of SBI Remit's cumulative ¥2.5T handling amount.
Current XRP-based remittance volume by corridor and settlement route.
Fasset MoU implementation status, launch date, stablecoin issuer(s), chain(s), banks and routes selected.
Whether Fasset infrastructure will replace, complement or coexist with SBI Remit's Ripple/XRP routes.
Actual Fasset annual transaction volume and wallet activity independently verified against primary network data.
data_quality: The ¥2.5T figure is cumulative total remittance handling, not XRP-only volume and not current capital inflow.
The 82.96% SBI Remit voting-rights ownership figure is dated 2026-08-28; do not assume 100% ownership.
SBI Ripple Asia's 60% voting-rights ownership is separate from SBI's approximately 9% Ripple Labs shareholding.
Fasset's $32B annual volume, 2M+ wallets, 16 chains and 50+ banks are company claims quoted in SBI's release; not independently validated here.
The Fasset relationship is an MoU, not evidence of a production deployment.
next_actions: Track SBI Remit/Fasset announcements for a production launch and asset/chain/corridor details.
Separate SBI Remit's total remittance volume from XRP-specific corridor volume in all future models.
Compare cost, speed, liquidity and asset routing across Ripple/XRP, Fasset stablecoins, JPYSC and fiat bank transfers.
Monitor whether Fasset uses XRP or only stablecoins in any SBI route; do not infer from network count.
